blog_article1.title: 3 Tips to Prevent Clogged Drains
blog_article1.excerpt: Discover how to keep your pipes healthy daily and avoid water backflow.
content: Clogged drains are one of the most common plumbing problems in Tangier homes. Often caused by the gradual accumulation of soap residue, hair and food grease, it can be avoided with a few simple daily habits.

First, installing a drain guard or sink strainer is essential in the shower and kitchen sink. This simple device catches hair and large debris before they enter the trap, preventing stubborn clogs from forming.

Second, get into the habit of never pouring used cooking fats or oils down your drains. As they cool, oils solidify and form a hard layer on pipe walls, which traps other debris. Instead, pour them into a sealed container and throw it in the trash.

Finally, regular maintenance with boiling water and baking soda works wonders. Once a week, pour a cup of baking soda followed by a liter of boiling water. This natural reaction dissolves accumulated grease and neutralizes bad odors ecologically, preserving the longevity of your pipes.

blog_article2.title: Which Water Heater Saves Energy?
blog_article2.excerpt: Technical comparison between traditional tank and tankless water heaters to reduce your electricity bill.
content: Hot water production represents a significant portion of household energy bills. In Tangier, with colder winter temperatures, choosing an efficient and economical water heating system is crucial for managing electricity or gas consumption.

The conventional electric water heater (tank type) stores water and maintains its temperature continuously. While it offers excellent comfort with immediate and constant hot water flow, it consumes energy constantly to keep water hot even when you're not home. This is what's called standby heat loss.

In contrast, tankless electric water heaters only heat water on demand when a tap is opened. With no reservoir, they completely eliminate storage-related energy losses. However, they require very high instantaneous electrical power and may show limitations when multiple water points are used simultaneously in large households.

For households looking to maximize savings, heat pump water heaters or solar water heaters represent the best modern alternatives. The heat pump model uses a mini heat pump to capture calories from the air and heat water, reducing electricity consumption by up to 70%. Although the initial investment is higher, the payback in Tangier is very fast thanks to our region's sunny climate.
